absent: Locking or concurrency rules for capability flags and topology globals and machine check state are not shown.
Full memory layouts for processor info and leaf tables and scan descriptors beyond offset access and cleared extents are not shown.
Semantics of vendor early hooks and feature filtering and defect computation and speculation handling and no operation discovery beyond invocation are not shown.
Numeric encodings for capability indices and control fields and timeout units beyond symbolic references are not shown.
Later activation of application processors and propagation of bootstrap topology and machine check state beyond bootstrap handling are not shown.

findings.text: Early boot processor identification establishes normalized per CPU state before later setup runs. It clears prior capability and enumeration state then follows an availability branch. On availability it performs enumeration plus vendor determination plus capability plus address discovery plus early command line adjustment plus topology discovery plus optional vendor hooks plus index assignment plus feature filtering plus dependency validation plus machine check bootstrap. On absence it records lack of support yet still sizes addresses and topology. It always forces a baseline capability and refreshes defect state and applies speculation handling and clears mode incompatible capabilities and suppresses wide paging reporting when paging is inactive and discovers no operation behavior.

Early command line adjustment can suppress selected capabilities before enumeration completes. Boolean option noxsave clears save support and boolean option noxsaveopt clears optimized save and boolean option noxsaves clears supervisor save and boolean option nousershstk clears user shadow stack, with 32 bit builds additionally honoring suppression of fast save restore. Value option fred with value off clears flexible return handling. List options clearcpuid and setcpuid respectively suppress or force arbitrary identification bits for testing, and any effective use produces a prominent warning and marks the kernel out of specification. This affects X86_FEATURE_XSAVE when requested and affects X86_FEATURE_XSAVEOPT when requested and affects X86_FEATURE_XSAVES when requested and affects X86_FEATURE_USER_SHSTK when requested and affects X86_FEATURE_FRED when requested and affects X86_FEATURE_FXSR on 32 bit.

Cached identification state is constructed by scanning a static descriptor table over a base range. A top scan delegates to a full scan that sizes the descriptor count and fills the table. Filling walks configured ranges and resets each one. Resetting skips descriptors outside the range and zeroes register plus info storage for covered descriptors and unconditionally reads the range anchor so the valid maximum becomes known and then reads only descriptors at or below that maximum. Clearing zeroes a bounded register group plus info. Maximum lookup consults subleaf zero of leaf zero for the base range and yields zero otherwise.

Cached leaf storage is reached through offset helpers that add a caller supplied displacement to the base of the leaf collection to obtain register state or parse metadata. Descriptors therefore stay compact while still addressing variable sized leaf data without embedding absolute addresses.

Dependency validation walks a static table of feature prerequisite pairs on the current processor and requires each enabled feature to have its prerequisite enabled. A violation produces at most one warning identifying the processor and both features by name. Name lookup prefers a static flag table and otherwise formats a numeric fallback from word index and bit position.

Identification leaf unlocking has an empty generic form and a gated vendor form. The vendor form returns without action unless the boot processor vendor matches Intel and the version meets a minimum threshold. It then attempts to clear a limit control in miscellaneous enable state and refreshes the cached maximum standard leaf from leaf zero only when that attempt reports a change.

Bootstrap machine check setup is gated on availability and known vendor, disabling itself with an informational note for unknown processors. It snapshots recovery plus succor plus scalable architecture indications into global flags and conditionally performs scalable bootstrap and reads capability state and selects accurate instruction pointer reporting when extended count allows and enables software recovery reporting when advertised and dispatches vendor quirks and normalizes monarch timeout plus panic timing, including a fixed panic interval when boot logging is active.

Global quirks tune machine check defaults by family and model. Older AMD suppresses boot logging by default and one AMD family range forces overflow recovery and a newer AMD range enables an instruction fetch workaround. Intel below an early threshold needs no action while newer Intel enables monarch synchronization with a one second timeout and older Intel suppresses boot logging and selected models enable fetch or repeat move workarounds. Zhaoxin enables monarch synchronization on newer families or selected models.

Scalable machine check bootstrap has a full form that assigns threshold plus deferred error vectors to vendor handlers and an empty fallback form used when the capability is unavailable. Callers select between them based on capability state.

Early topology construction moves from scan to global geometry to identity assignment. It parses topology into a scan descriptor and copies domain shifts to system state and derives the smallest domain size directly and each larger size from the shift gap to its predecessor and assigns identifiers and records a node count that cannot be inferred from APIC identity. Single domain update writes one level while domain set additionally propagates values upward.

Topology parsing starts from defaults with unknown type and invalid cache identities and honors a fake override and seeds initial APIC identity from a fixed leaf. Early boot uses that initial value before mapping while later boot reads hardware. Single processor builds stop after that. Multiprocessor handling derives a count shift and dispatches by vendor toward AMD or legacy or extended paths, with Intel additionally sampling hybrid type when maximum leaf permits and mapping encodings to efficiency or performance classes and AMD mapping its own encodings including low power.

AMD discovery tries modern extended parsing first and then older sources in order. An older leaf supplies thread count plus shift with a count derived fallback when shift is zero and assumes one thread per core until later parsers refine it. A topology extension leaf can refresh APIC identity plus threading geometry on newer families and records node count plus node identity plus cache identity. A node control provides a final fallback. Cache identity defaults to shifted APIC value when unset, and multinode packages advertise a distributed cache capability.

Two firmware hazards are mitigated. When the lowest extended subleaf reports zero shift yet multiple processors, the parser derives a corrected shift from the count and warns once. On a narrow AMD family plus model window lacking topology extensions, the code attempts to re enable the feature through a control and on verified success sets the capability and logs once.

Enumeration relies on fixed leaf identities as facts. Standard extended topology prefers 0x1F and then falls back to 0x0B while AMD extended topology prefers 0x80000026. Legacy AMD uses 0x80000008 and also 0x8000001E. Hybrid type uses 0x1A on Intel and a type field from 0x80000026 on AMD when heterogeneous support is enabled. Initial APIC identity comes from leaf 1. Node fallback uses a family 10h node control.

Public early interfaces exposed for other boot paths comprise identification scanning plus dependency validation plus Intel leaf unlocking plus machine check bootstrap plus scalable bootstrap plus topology initialization plus domain helpers plus AMD parsing plus extended parsing plus CPU type mapping. They are invoked during bootstrap identification and may be reused by later setup.
